scope.direct_baseline: Skill-free local Codex Astra receiving the entire canonical pool; not raw model weights.
scope.research_evidence: Every eligible source version remains visible with exact prefix offsets; fair allocation up to 16000 characters each and 60000 total. Same-URL versions are not independent evidence.
scope.formal_evidence: Initial canonical version plus selected eligible snapshots. Bounded research advice is visible as untrusted proposals; it cannot admit evidence or resolve gaps.
scope.future_scores: Abstention is not advance detection; matching later falsehood can be unjustified by cutoff evidence.
scope.usage: Logical invocations include failures; internal CLI retries are not separately controlled. Cached input is included in input tokens, not added again.
scope.future_screen: Final rationale/quote year screening only; absence does not establish absence of model memory.
